description: Compare a blueprint against the live server: what the blueprint expects but the server lacks (missing), what exists but differs (changed, with the fields), and what the server has that the blueprint never mentioned (extra, informational). Reads the blueprint as the whole truth, so a setting it leaves out counts as its default. The drift detector for config-as-code workflows. To act on it, plan_server_build applies changes with update_existing and deletes extras listed in remove.

id.description: Discord id from export_server_blueprint. Matches this exact item, so a new name renames it.

permissions.description: Extra permissions per role here, beyond who can see and post (private_to, read_only, posting_roles). Example: [{"role": "Event Staff", "allow": ["mention_everyone", "embed_links"]}]. A listed role's extras become exactly these; roles not listed keep theirs.

posting_roles.description: With read_only: role names that may still post and start threads.

private_to.description: Role names that can see this channel; everyone else is denied view. [] leaves only admins. null makes it visible to everyone. Omit to follow the category.

read_only.description: Deny sending for everyone; for rules and announcements.
